name: metadator
description: Automatically generate metadata for Obsidian notes using AI
author: Mark Ayers

scripts.dev: bun build src/main.ts --outdir . --format cjs --external obsidian --external electron --sourcemap=linked --watch
scripts.build: bun run check && bun build src/main.ts --outdir . --format cjs --external obsidian --external electron --minify && bun run deploy.ts
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && biome check . && bun fmt --check "**/*.md"
